_about: George Finlay (1799-1875): A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, B.C. 146 to A.D. 1864, the 1877 Oxford edition revised by H. F. Tozer, complete in 7 vols. The earlier separate histories it absorbed are not taken.

finlay-history-greece-v1-1877: A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, vol. I: Greece under the Romans (ed. H. F. Tozer, Oxford, 1877)
finlay-history-greece-v2-1877: A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, vol. II: The Byzantine Empire, part 1 (ed. H. F. Tozer, Oxford, 1877)
finlay-history-greece-v3-1877: A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, vol. III: The Byzantine Empire, part 2 (ed. H. F. Tozer, Oxford, 1877)
finlay-history-greece-v4-1877: A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, vol. IV: Mediaeval Greece and Trebizond (ed. H. F. Tozer, Oxford, 1877)
finlay-history-greece-v5-1877: A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, vol. V: Greece under Othoman and Venetian Domination (ed. H. F. Tozer, Oxford, 1877)
finlay-history-greece-v6-1877: A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, vol. VI: The Greek Revolution, part 1 (ed. H. F. Tozer, Oxford, 1877)
finlay-history-greece-v7-1877: A History of Greece from its Conquest by the Romans to the Present Time, vol. VII: The Greek Revolution, part 2, and the Kingdom of Greece (ed. H. F. Tozer, Oxford, 1877)
